page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text with Hebrew, Syriac and Greek inline; no marginal notes; catchword-like signature "Qq" at foot centre (signature). Running head "LEX. CHALD. ET SYR." at top with page number 305.

main_text.p: in T.H.Respondet Hebraeo צלצל, unde alii speciem quandam locustae explicant: alii Muscam, propter convenientiam vocis, Onkelos סקאררא, unde videtur servile.

מסר Ch. Dare, tradere, dedere, prodere. Ithpehal אתמסר, vel אתמסר ex Ithpahel Dari, Tradi. Pah. מסר Serrare, Serra secare vel dissecare, 1.Reg.7.9. Sic etiam quidam illud explicat ומסר יתהון במסרין Et tradidit eos in serras; Et dissecuit illos serris, 2. Sam. 12.31. Hac significatione convenit cum נסר Aphel מסרו Et ignominiam contempsit, juxta Regia, quomodo אמסר idem esset quod אנסר. Tremellius; Et confusioni se exposuit, Vide ejus notas, ad Hebraeos 12.2. Gr. αἰσχύνης καταφρονήσας.
מסרא, מסרא Ch. Serra. Plur. מסרין. Hebr. משור, a נשר.
מסת Chal. Sufficientia, sufficiens, satis, abundans. Sic Syr. ܣܦܩܐ Cum usu sufficientiae nostrae, 1.ad Tim.6.6.
מעא, מעא Ch. Obolus, Numulus, מעא דכסף Obolus argenteus. Plur. מעין.

מעז Ch. Venter, Pf.127.3. Plur. מעין, מעי, מעיא Viscera, Intestina, Venter, & cum מעין Jesa. 13.18. Item ex forma duali מעיין Jesa. 44.24. & foemin. מען Pf.58. 4. Syr. ܕܘܟܢܐ Dolor viscerum, Gr. δυσεντερία, Act.28.8.
מעינא Chald. Idem, Cant.7.2. & Psalm.22.11. Eccles.11. 5. Vide quoque עין.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are rendered as far as legible; several Hebrew vowel-pointed forms and Syriac script are approximate. Marginal Hebrew-letter headwords (מסר, מסר, מסת, מעא, מעז) are printed as large initials in the left margin and are transcribed inline.
